Another short one to end the over, Harris cuts this beautifully square on the off side once more. The ball is in the gap and Shami does well in the deep to cut the ball just in front of the ropes using some footwork. Two taken.
Draws the batsman ahead with a flighted one outside off, the ball is driven to mid off.
Loopy ball on off and middle, defended back with a straight bat by MH.
Shorter length outside off, Harris cuts this one away square on the off side. The sweeper comes around and cuts the ball to keep it to two.
Slightly quicker and on middle again, pushed to mid on.
Lots of air on this ball dropped on middle stump line, Harris pushes it back to the bowler.
Kuldeep Yadav replaces Mohammed Shami in the attack. Both spinners in action very, very early. A slip and short leg in place. A different challenge now for the Aussie openers.
Flatter and quicker on middle, defended back down the ground.

FOUR! The Aussies are taking the attack to Jadeja here, a definite plan it looks like. Looped up slightly outside off, Khawaja comes down the ground and lifts this over the head of mid off for a boundary.
Fuller one on middle, flicked away by Harris towards mid-wicket. Kohli does not field it properly and allows a single as he fumbles.

FOUR! Well adjusted by Harris, brilliant hands! Jadeja drops this one short seeing the batsman come down the ground but the southpaw adjusts and beautifully plays the cover drive instead and gets it in the gap for a boundary.
Fuller one outside off, pushed it down to mid off.
Flatter one outside off, swept away to deep square leg by Khawaja for a single.

FOUR! Glorious! Slightly overpitched and outside off, Harris strides forward and drives it delightfully past the diving cover fielder for a boundary. 11 from the over, Australia off to a positive start.
That's the length Khawaja likes. It's a touch short around middle and leg, Usman turns it in front of square leg and picks up a run.
Lovely hands! Shami lands it on a length outside off, Khawaja with a minimum front foot movement steers it past point. Jadeja chases it down and prevents a boundary. Two taken.
Pitches it up and outside off, Usman drives it off his front foot to covers. Looking quite good and positive, Khawaja.
FOUR! Bumrah tries to go dead straight with his line but the angle takes it down and Khawaja easily deflects it off his pads to the fine leg boundary.
Serves it on a good length and outside off, Khawaja has his front leg forward to cover the line as he makes a leave.

In between the overs... Umpire Ian Gould calls out KL Rahul and praises him for his reaction after the ball dropped in front of him while attempting a catch. Calls him and Says 'Outstanding mate!!' These are the kind of things that help the umpires as well. And also helps the game move on smoothly.
Shorter one to end the over, Marcus plays it off the back foot towards point.
Looped up outside off, defended on the front foot to Jadeja by MH.
Flatter one on middle, defended back down the ground.
FOUR! Short outside off, cut away beautifully by Harris this time. Rocks back and deposits this one for four through point.
Fuller one outside off, pushed to cover.

Chance! Falls just short and Rahul signals immediately that the ball has bounced in front of him! A really good effort that, but it just did not carry. Loops this one outside off, Harris comes down the track and looks to loft it over mid on but can only lift it as far as to the right of mid on. Rahul moves to his right, dives to take this one but just can't reach the ball. Stands up and immediately says that it had gone to ground. Harris survives a scare.
Ravindra Jadeja is the first change this morning.
Delivers this one outside off stump, pushed away to cover defensively by UK.
Good ball! Keeps a trifle low too. On a length and coming back in, Usman Khawaja does well to stay low and keep it out.
Pushes the length up by a bit, left alone by the batsman.
Short of a length ball well outside off, pulled away through mid-wicket for a couple by Khawaja.

Beautifully punched down the ground towards long on by Harris here. Very full and Marcus presents a very straight bat to this ball as he pushes it down the ground. Single taken as Hardik Pandya, the substitute fielder, chases and stops this.
Fuller length outside off, a solid looking drive to mid off by Harris.
Another dot ball to end the over. Length ball outside off that is left alone by Khawaja. Maiden over.
On the money constantly here Bumrah, this one on off stump is kept out towards covers by the batsman.
Good length delivery outside off, UK comes ahead and defends this onto the ground.
Shortens the length outside off, it is left alone by the southpaw.
Almost similar length as the previous one and similarly defended by the batsman.
Length ball outside off, defended by Khawaja who was half-ahead.
Khawaja is away for the day as he works this length ball through mid-wicket and gets a single.
Pulls the length back and puts it outside off, it's left alone by Khawaja.
Very full outside off, driven straight to KL Rahul at covers.
Length ball outside off, pushed away wide of point for a single.
A little fuller than the previous ball, slightly outside off. Harris prods ahead again and tries to drive. Gets a thick outside edge that runs to point.
On a good length outside off, Harris comes ahead and defends this one.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end.
Another leave outside off from Usman to end the over.
Well outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Slightly outside off, Usman has a look and then lets it go.

A slight appeal! The ball was on a good length and going on with the angle from around the wicket. The ball seemed to have struck Khawaja's thigh pad as he missed his flick. The umpire says no, looked like the ball was too high.

Did you know? Jasprit Bumrah completes one year in Test cricket today. He made his debut on 5th January 2018 against South Africa in Cape Town and has already become the backbone of the Indian bowling attack.
Brings the length back to a good length this time and hurls it outside off, Khawaja stands tall and defends.
Runs off the very first ball, nice check-drive down the ground to this full one, to the left of mid off. Easy three taken.

Today is the Pink Day at the SCG and the players from both sides are seen handing over the pink caps to the Australian great, Glenn McGrath. Now, the Indian unit is in a huddle with Virat Kohli sharing some words of wisdom. The Australian batting pair is already in the middle. Marcus Harris is taking guard. Jasprit Bumrah to kick off proceedings this morning. All set, let's play...

For the visitors, they are under relatively less pressure having posted that massive 622 on board. They will look to bowl tight lines, keep up the pressure and wait for the hosts to wilt and throw wickets. The weather is expected to be sunny for the first couple of hours and then become cloudy with a chance of thunderstorms towards the evening. As for the surface, it has looked a very good one to bat on so far and is expected to continue that way. Will be interesting to see if Jadeja or Kuldeep can extract something from the wicket. A lovely day in store, action should begin soon.

Coming to the game at hand, India are ahead by 598 runs. That says something, Australia have to surely do something extraordinary to come back in this one. They will have to go score quickly while always believing that they can still win from here as losing hope will be derogatory to their cause. 3 days of cricket is yet to be played and strange things have happened in Tests so just do what is expected currently and then take the game from there. Bat at a good click and bat long will be the agenda.

Welcome to Day 3 of the final Test between Australia and India at the SCG. It could be the day which could potentially show us which way this game is going but it is also a very important day for a much more important reason than just cricket. It is also the Jane McGrath Day of the Pink Test. It is an initiative which sees the McGrath Foundation that is a  breast cancer support and education charity in Australia, raise money to place McGrath Breast Care Nurses in communities across Australia and increase breast health awareness in the country. The stadium becomes pink and is a lovely sight too.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

For the action on Saturday, join us at 1030 local (2330 GMT, previous night). Till then, take care and cheers! You can also switch tabs to the Cape Town Test between Pakistan and South Africa where 12 wickets fell on the first day and the hosts are firmly in control. It will begin shortly. Cheers!

Looking forward to the play on Day 3. The pitch still appears to be a really good one to bat on and Australia have no reason why they can't put their heads down and go after this massive total. That said, Jasprit Bumrah and co. have been really good and will always possess a threat too. The dark horse could be Kuldeep Yadav playing his first Test in this series. There are also some thunderstorms forecast for the day and we will have to wait and see how it all pans out. Should be a day of cricket worth watching though. As of now, India are firmly in the driver's seat, ahead by 598 runs.

As for the remaining part of Day 2, we saw the Indian batting line-up take the hosts bowlers to the cleaners and put up a massive first innings total of 622/7. Cheteshwar Pujara and Rishabh Pant both brought up daddy hundreds and Pant eventually remained unbeaten on 159. The others played around and Australia were deflated. Such was the domination that even Pat Cummins was taken for 16 runs in an over by Jadeja this evening and Nathan Lyon ended up bowling the most number of overs by him in an innings of a Test match. Kohli eventually decided to declare and put the Aussie openers in for a test of 10 overs which they managed to pass.

A good end to the day for the Aussies after what has been a grueling 167.2 overs out in the field for them. Marcus Harris and Usman Khawaja have managed to see through the tricky phase before Stumps without any damage and not much trouble. Although, there was a scare for Khawaja when he was dropped on 0 by Pant. The ball is not doing much from the surface either for the spinners or for the fast bowlers, at least so far, so Australia should feel confident and come out positive on Day 3. Whether they can get a result in their favor or not remains to be seen but what they can do is to make a good response to this total that India have set them. There seems to be no demons which will stand in their way other than their own mistakes.
This one is well outside off and Usman Khawaja lets it go. Maiden over and THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 2. Australia have done well to end the day unscathed at 24/0 after 10 overs.
Lots of flight outside off, Khawaja prods ahead and dead-bats.
Another one with air on it outside off, Usman defends solidly.
Flighted on middle again, UK defends it well back to the bowler.
Looped up on middle, defended with a straight bat.
Kuldeep with what should be the final over of the day. Loops up the first one outside off, driven by Khawaja to a deepish cover.
A touch short and outside off, Khawaja gets back and hits it square of the wicket on the off side for a run.
Flighted and outside off, Usman strides forward to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends.
Spinning back in from outside off, defended to the off side.
Walks forward to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flighted and full outside off, not much turn, Khawaja gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Fuller ball outside off, driven down the ground to mid off.
Fuller one outside off, Harris comes ahead and defends this one onto the ground.

Almost had him! Beautiful drift on that and the ball held its line. Khawaja tried to defend it but the ball skidded on and went onto the bat quickly. It took the inside edge and went to the leg side for a single. Lucky escape there.
Flatter one bowled quicker than the previous two. Usman defends it from within the crease.
Flighted outside off, defended on the front foot by Khawaja.
Wonderful drift first up, the ball on middle is turned away just in time towards square leg for a single.
Indeed, Kohli has opted for spin from both ends. It's time for Kuldeep Yadav.
Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and pushes it towards mid on. A maiden to start with for Jadeja!
Flatter outside off, defensively pushed towards cover.
Will there be spin from both ends?
Quicker one at the pads, turned towards mid-wicket.
Well outside off this time, keeps a little low. Khawaja defends it well staying low.
Flatter one on off and middle, kept out by the batsman.
Fuller outside off to start, driven towards mid off.
Here comes the spinner! Ravindra Jadeja it is. A slip and short leg in place.
Fullish and on off, Khawaja drives it in the gap at covers for a single.
A 145 kph short delivery, around middle and leg, Harris tries fending at it and the ball goes off his gloves towards square leg. A run taken.
Back of a length delivery on top of off stump, Harris stands back and defends it down.
A bouncer, around leg, Harris comfortably sits underneath it.
Full and on off, Marcus gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Angles it into the batsman, Khawaja plays it close to his body, closes the face of his bat and bunts it wide of mid on for a quick run.
A touch short in length on off, Harris punches it firmly off his back foot to covers where Vihari dives to stop the racing ball.
Pitches it up outside off and invites the drive. Marcus gets forward and plays the stroke but all along the ground to the cover fielder.
This time Harris solidly gets behind the line of a good length ball and defends it watchfully.
Fullish and around off, angling in, Harris gets forward and flicks it with nice timing through mid-wicket. Will get two for this shot.
Digs in a short delivery around off, Harris goes on his toes and taps it down safely on the off side.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Usman works it wide of mid on and gets off the mark on the 8th ball he faces.
Length ball on the pads, kept out towards square leg.

FOUR! Gorgeous shot! This wicket is a batting beauty but you have to play good shots to get your runs. Outside off on a length this time, Harris times this wonderfully wide of a diving point fielder for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, driven towards Jadeja at mid off.
Bouncer! Harris ducks under this one.
Fuller length ball targeted on off stump, pushed on the front foot towards mid on.
Short length ball outside off, defended on the back foot towards the bowler.

Oooh! Another leave outside off and trust me, the ball wasn't far away from the off stump. Around the wicket and the ball was coming in. Khawaja gauges the swing and lets it go. Decent leave but could have been risky.
Fuller one on the stumps, driven down the ground but straight to mid on. No run available.
Outside off and this time Usman leaves it very late.

Dropped! Pant has put Khawaja down! A regulation catch, goes in and out of the gloves. Full length ball outside off and slightly shaping away. Khawaja pokes at it without much foot movement. The ball goes at a good height to Pant who dives to his left to take this one. Seems like he was a little late to start there. The left hand glove reached first and the right glove was trailing. Not able to cup it up with two hands hence. Might just be fatigue but Khawaja gets a life! Let's see how much this will come to haunt the Indians.
Well outside off this time, left alone by Khawaja.
Short of a length ball outside off, Harris pulls this away to deep backward square leg for a single.

Outside off on a length, takes the outer half of the bat of Harris who was looking to push at this one and runs wide of point towards the fence. Rahane gives chase and manages to scramble it inside. 3 runs taken.
Short of a length ball, doesn't bounce as much as Harris expects. Looks to duck under it but leaves the bat up there. Could have been risky.
Short of a length ball on middle, Harris gets on top of the bounce and defends the ball.
Very straight this time and nicely tucked away by Harris towards the square leg region. The ball doesn't reach the fence and the batsmen pick up two.
Very full and on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Around the wicket, fuller outside off and angling away slightly. Harris tries to push it down the ground but gets the thick outer half of the bat and the ball rolls towards point.
Jasprit Bumrah to share the cherry.
Fuller length this time, Usman defends it onto the leg side towards short mid-wicket.
Shorter length outside off, Khawaja defends from the crease onto the off side.
Length ball outside off, pushed towards cover. The batsmen pick up an easy single.

FOUR! Good shot! That will give the batsman some confidence. Short of a length ball outside off, Harris is on the back foot and punches it away to deep point for a boundary. First runs for both Marcus and Australia.

Almost chopped on second ball! Harris is tired and does not move his feet to this length ball as he tries to push it through the covers off the back foot. The ball takes the under edge and bounces just next to the off stump and behind.
Around the wicket to Harris, he pushes this good length ball to mid on.
